label: Power ball count
subgoals: Divide the rail current by the per-ball limit
Round up and double for the return
Place power under the die and signals outside

label: Target impedance
subgoals: Multiply the supply by the ripple fraction
Divide by the transient current step
Assign frequency bands to board, package and die

label: Parallel paths and inductance
subgoals: Divide the per-path inductance by the target
Round up to a whole number of paths
Account for mutual coupling by interleaving
